verdict.rationale: Maritime has a live, HTTP-200 llms.txt (maritime-probe-1) plus a dedicated CLI llms.txt (maritime-docs-9) and general agent-oriented docs explicitly designed for pointing agents like Claude Code at them (maritime-docs-16). This directly matches the story of an AI-native user directing an agent at agent-friendly documentation. Missing for 10: no evidence of an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (docs.md and openapi.json both 404 per maritime-probe-2/3), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent successfully consuming llms.txt in practice.
